content: An essential criterion for an image captioning model is that the captions generated are grammatically well-formed. Fully accurate assessment of grammaticality in a general context is itself a difficult task, but becomes more feasible in a very constrained context like our diagnostic language data. We take parseability with the English Resource Grammar BIBREF23 as a surrogate for grammaticality, meaning that a sentence is considered grammatically well-formed if we obtain a parse using the ERG.
